summary.text: On Mirrodin, the Phyrexian assault intensifies while the Mirran resistance rallies, with Mirrans recruiting constructs, golems and Myr to the war and the Phyrexians spreading unevenly across the plane.

Elspeth, Koth and Venser break into Phyrexian territory and free Melira, who is immune to phyresis and heals the infected rebels at Ezuri's camp, while Karn is trapped in his own mind as the Phyrexians try to force a role on him.

Venser gives his life and spark to cure Karn, who asks the group to lead the resistance with Melira, but Elesh Norn's influence grows as she conquers rival domains, and Glissa is corrupted and turns traitor.
